origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: Ihe nkedo mmiri nke na-eji ebili mmiri na mmiri na-agwọ ọrịa. N'ụlọ n'oké osimiri, mana akpọnwụwo n'ala kpọrọ nkụ.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: Gwuo cone mmiri na-aga n'ihu, na-emebi mmebi 4 na ịchụpụ ndị iro. 5-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Hapụ ebili mmiri na-agwọ ọrịa na-eweghachi gị 6 HP na ndị egwuregwu nọ nso. Ọ na-efu 3 mana. 10-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Mmiri
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.desc: Na-eku ume n'okpuru mmiri ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_swim_speed.d: Na-egwu mmiri ngwa ngwa karịa ka ọ dị.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Jiri nwayọ weghachi ahụike mgbe ị na-emikpu n'ime mmiri.
Mebie ọzara na badland - ikuku kpọrọ nkụ na-emebi ike gị.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: Na-emebi emebi
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: Mebie 25% obere mmebi melee. Ike gị na-agafe na mmiri, ọ bụghị akwara.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Ọkụ Mage
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: Pyromancer na-agbanwe agbanwe nke a na-awụ n'ire ọkụ - na-atụba bọọlụ ọkụ, gbawa n'ọkụ, wee gbaa ndị na-eti gị ọkụ. Ọkụ enweghị ike imerụ gị ahụ, mana mmiri bụ mmebi gị.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Ọkụ ọkụ
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: Tụgharịa volley nke obere bọọlụ ọkụ anọ na ntụzịaka ị na-ele. Ọ na-efu 3 mana. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Hapụ ire ọkụ na-emebi ndị iro niile dị nso. Ọ na-efu 3 mana. 8-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Ndị na-awakpo na-ewere 30% nke mmebi ha na-eme dị ka mmegwara ọkụ.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: Ihe na-egbochi ọkụ, lava, na magma na-egbochi mmebi. Lava na-ekpo ọkụ naanị.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Were mmebi 1 kwa nkeji mgbe ị nọ na mmiri ma ọ bụ mmiri ozuzo.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Igwe ọkụ dị n'ime
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Agụụ na-agbapụ 50% ngwa ngwa site na okpomọkụ dị n'ime.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Ikuku mage
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: Onye na-anya ụgbọelu na-agba ọsọ nke na-atụfu ụgwọ ifufe, na-ebugharị ifufe nke mbugharị, ma na-agbago elu na mbara igwe. Ìhè dị ka ikuku, ma adịghị ike dị ka akwụkwọ.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Gbaa ụgwọ ikuku nke na-eme ka mgbawa ịkụ azụ na mmetụta.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Ifufe
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Tụfuo bolt ikuku nke na-ebute oke ifufe na mmetụta - dọkpụrụ, bulie, ma tụgharịa ihe ndị dị nso maka sekọnd anọ. Ọnụ ego 4 mana.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Nkwalite
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Mepee onwe gị na mbara igwe na kọlụm ikuku.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Ikuku ikuku na-egbochi ọdịda gị - ị gaghị emebi ọdịda.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Na-ebu site na ifufe ọdụ mgbe niile - na-ebugharị 20% ngwa ngwa n'ụkwụ.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: Ọdịda nku
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: Gbada nwayọọ nwayọọ, dị ka a ga-asị na ike ndọda adịghị emetụta. Jiri igodo nka gbanyụọ mgbe ịchọrọ ịda ngwa ngwa.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Fragile Fragile
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 obi (-4 max HP). A naghị arụ ikuku ka ọ dịgide.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: Dị fechaa
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: Were 50% ọzọ ịkụ azụ - ikuku na-ebu gị ngwa ngwa.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Ike ndọda
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: A warper nke gravitational ubi onye ekwe ohere onwe ya. Ma-ọbu kpochapu ndi-iro-gi: ma aru-gi esighi n'uwa puta.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: Ike ndọda nke ọma
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Gbanyụọ orb gbara ọchịchịrị na-adaba n'ime oghere ojii na mmetụta. A na-adọta ụlọ ọrụ ndị dị nso na etiti ya wee mebie maka sekọnd anọ. Ọnụ ego 4 mana. 20-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: Hapụ ụda ujo ndọda nke na-agbapụ ihe niile dị nso. Ọ na-efu 3 mana. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: Enwere ike ịgbagharị: mebie ike ndọda wee bilie na iwu (Levitation I). Gbanyụọ na ndabara - jiri igodo nka gbanye.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Were 75% nkwughachi azụ - ike ike ike gị na-eme ka ọ dị mfe ịmalite.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: Ike ike
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: Mebie 25% obere mmebi melee. Ike gị dị na ịdọrọ, ọ bụghị ntu.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: Ọchịchịrị Mage
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: Onye na-agba afa na-akpa onyinyo onyinyo nke na-akpọ orbs onyinyo na-agbagharị agbagharị na nzọụkwụ n'etiti ọdọ mmiri nke ọchịchịrị. Uwe mkpuchi na-egbu egbu n'abalị, mana ìhè anyanwụ na-erepịa ike gị.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: Debe oghere ndò n'ebe ị nọ nke na-ebute ndị iro dị nso ọchịchịrị na ìsì. Ihe ruru orbs 3 na-arụ ọrụ ozugbo. Ọ na-efu 3 mana. 5-nkeji oyi.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Teleport gaa ebe ị na-ele anya, ihe ruru 24 blocks. Ọ na-efu 2 mana. 4-nkeji nke abụọ.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Hụ nke ọma n'ọchịchịrị zuru oke. Jiri igodo ọhụụ abalị tụgharịa (nke ndabara K).
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: Ndị na-eme ihe ike na-achọpụta gị site na naanị 40% nke oke ha.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Were 1 mmebi kwa nkeji na ìhè anyanwụ kpọmkwem.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: Nke m 30% ji nwayọọ nwayọọ - ìhè nke ekpuchiri elu na-agba gị anya.
